title: First call with Khala
tagline: She's calling Sunday. You will not just say 'haan' for 20 minutes.
canDo: You can hold your own on a call with Khala: greet, catch up, survive the rishta question, and hang up politely

sessions.title: Pick up properly
sessions.blurb: Salaam, how are you, can you hear me?

sessions.title: Catch up
sessions.blurb: What you're doing, where you are, the weather.

sessions.title: Hang up like a pro
sessions.blurb: Salaams to everyone, call back later, Khuda hafiz.

title: Nani is visiting
tagline: Two weeks. Your house. Her rules. Her cooking. Prepare accordingly.
canDo: You can welcome Nani, eat what she cooks, praise it properly, and never once say 'tu'

sessions.title: Chai time
sessions.blurb: Tea, less sugar, and whatever she wants.

sessions.title: Family talk
sessions.blurb: She will quiz you on who's who.
